rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when the context makes clear that the hearing was accidental or unintended.

example.english: I overhear them saying they are not coming home tonight.
example.traditional: 我喺門口等緊嗰陣，聽到佢哋講今晚唔返屋企。
example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 mun4 hau2 dang2 gan2 go2 zan6 teng1 dou3 keoi5 dei6 gong2 gam1 maan1 m4 faan1 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this when you want to stress that you happened to hear something not meant for you.

example.english: I accidentally overhear my colleague saying that the boss is not coming to the office tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我行過茶水間嗰陣，唔覺意聽到同事講老闆聽日唔返公司。
example.jyutping: ngo5 haang4 gwo3 caa4 seoi2 gaan1 go2 zan6 m4 gok3 ji3 teng1 dou3 tung4 si6 gong2 lou5 baan2 ting1 jat6 m4 faan1 gung1 si1
